items.source_en:
Due to ongoing shortages, rationing protocols are now in effect.

• All food and water are issued on a fixed daily allotment
• Distribution is limited to designated times and locations
• No additional portions without authorization
• Personal reserves must be declared and logged
• Hoarding or diversion of supplies will result in restriction of access
• Perishable goods are to be consumed within assigned intervals
• Priority allocation is given to active duty roles and critical operations

These measures ensure our continued survival.
